senses.zh_definition: 英语中使用的男性名字 Seth，常音译为“塞思”；圣经人物同名时常译为“塞特”。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name used in English, including the name of a biblical figure.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang digunakan dalam bahasa Inggeris, termasuk nama seorang tokoh dalam Bible.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 表示专有名词。现代姓名、圣经人物与同形的其他专名不能自动视为同一所指。下列是姓名的句法用例，并非固定搭配；马来语释义为编写性说明。[Behind the Name：Seth](https://www.behindthename.com/name/seth-1)

etymology.historical_story: The English given name Seth comes from Hebrew Sheth, associated with the meaning placed or set. In the biblical narrative, Seth is a son of Adam and Eve. The same Latin spelling also names an Egyptian deity through a separate naming tradition, so spelling alone cannot establish which history applies to an unidentified occurrence. [Biblical name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/seth-1), [separate name entries](https://www.behindthename.com/name/seth)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Seth /sɛθ/：一拍读完，末尾 /θ/ 轻轻送气；把声音和人名联系，不把它硬译成普通词义。
